title: After done, termal_release_named_root and termal_name_source_root give contradicting answers for the same root
outcome: After a claim ends by completion, a holder gets one consistent answer about its named root, and the root's slot doesn't stay occupied.
acceptance: After done, release either succeeds, or says the root retires by itself and when, and no refusal points at a remedy that is refused in turn; a behaviour test covers the moment between done and retirement.
It's established whether the slot stays occupied or retires at the next opening. If it stays, it's fixed. A review pair has no Medium or higher and the normal gate passes, if code changes.
